mapper.sql: select a.apply_id, a.apply_no, a.work_id, a.author_id, a.slot_type, a.slot_no, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.days, a.amount, a.source, a.status, a.pay_status, a.pay_time, a.banner_id, a.material_url, a.reject_reason, a.lock_expire_at, a.audit_by, a.audit_time, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, w.title as work_title, w.cover as work_cover, u.nick_name as author_name from sys_promotion_application a left join sys_work w on w.work_id = a.work_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.author_id
mapper.select:
AND a.slot_type = #{slotType} AND a.status = #{status} AND a.author_id = #{authorId} AND a.work_id = #{workId} AND a.apply_no = #{applyNoQuery}
AND (w.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.apply_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.status = 'pending'
AND a.status = 'approved' AND a.pay_status = 'unpaid' AND a.lock_expire_at > sysdate()
AND a.status = 'paid' AND a.start_time > sysdate()
AND a.status = 'paid' AND a.start_time <= sysdate() AND a.end_time >= sysdate()
AND a.status = 'paid' AND a.end_time < sysdate()
AND a.status = 'rejected' AND a.status = 'cancelled'
order by a.create_time desc, a.apply_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_promotion_application( apply_no, work_id, author_id, slot_type, slot_no, start_time, end_time, days, amount, source, status, pay_status, pay_time, banner_id, material_url, reject_reason, lock_expire_at, audit_by, audit_time, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{applyNo}, #{workId}, #{authorId}, #{slotType}, #{slotNo}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{days}, #{amount}, #{source}, #{status}, #{payStatus}, #{payTime}, #{bannerId}, #{materialUrl}, #{rejectReason}, #{lockExpireAt}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_promotion_application set status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, lock_expire_at = #{lockExpireAt}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where apply_id = #{applyId} and status = 'pending'

update sys_promotion_application set status = 'paid', pay_status = 'paid', pay_time = #{payTime}, lock_expire_at = null, update_time = sysdate() where apply_id = #{applyId} and status = 'approved' and pay_status = 'unpaid'
update sys_promotion_application set status = 'cancelled', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where apply_id = #{applyId} and status in ('pending', 'approved', 'paid')
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from sys_promotion_application where slot_type = #{slotType} and source = 'author_paid' and pay_status = 'paid' and date_format(pay_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(sysdate(), '%Y-%m')

select a.apply_id, a.apply_no, a.work_id, a.author_id, a.slot_type, a.slot_no, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.material_url, a.banner_id, w.title as work_title, w.cover as work_cover from sys_promotion_application a join sys_work w on w.work_id = a.work_id and w.is_deleted = 0 where a.slot_type = 'banner' and a.status = 'paid' and a.start_time <= #{now} and a.end_time >= #{now} and (a.material_url is not null or a.banner_id is not null) and w.status = 'on_shelf' order by a.slot_no asc, a.apply_id asc

select a.apply_id, a.apply_no, a.work_id, a.author_id, a.slot_type, a.slot_no, a.start_time, a.end_time, w.title as work_title, w.cover as work_cover from sys_promotion_application a join sys_work w on w.work_id = a.work_id and w.is_deleted = 0 and w.status = 'on_shelf' where a.slot_type = #{slotType} and a.status = 'paid' and a.start_time <= #{now} and a.end_time >= #{now} order by a.slot_no asc, a.apply_id asc
